events.title: Update 0.2.5: New Quests and a Portal
events.summary: This patch reworks quests: there is now a chain of main quests and a choice of side quests in the quest log. The attack shop now only increases damage, and the fortune teller has a new curse. The game picks your language and resolution on first launch, the interface no longer shrinks on large monitors and fits on small ones, anxiety warns you more clearly before it starts draining health, and the light near the crib and wells is softer. events.title: Update 0.2.4: Fortune Teller and Ruined Well
events.summary: This patch adds a fortune-telling ball with cards and a ruined well with a special quest to the forest, gives the characters clear stats, and quest rewards are now handed out in their own window. Fortune-telling ball A fortune-telling ball stands in one of the forest clearings, and an arrow at the edge of the screen points to it. events.title: Patch 0.2.3 - chests, a new quest and more enemies

events.title: Patch 0.2.2 - the main monster now comes to you
events.summary: Hi!This patch changes how a run ends. Many players ran out of time before finding the main monster or didn't know where to go, so I reworked the ending: the monster now comes to the hero on its own when time runs out.Main monsterThe main monster appears on its own when the countdown at the top of the screen reaches zero. events.title: Update 0.2.1: Quests and Five New Attacks

events.title: Demo update 0.2.0: difficulty levels, new characters and tutorial
events.summary: The Dreamfend demo has received update 0.2.0!This patch brings a number of changes so that players with little experience can settle into the world of Dreamfend without dying at the very start of a run.Difficulty- I added difficulty levels when choosing a level: there are now easy, normal and hard modes. events.title: The Dreamfend Demo is here!
events.summary: The demo is finally live!You can now download and play the Dreamfend demo for free. Run through fights, defeat the final boss, unlock rewards and new attacks, and spend upgrade points on ability branches. Mix and match weapons and passives — and see what the full game is shaping up to be.This is still an early build, so if you run into any bugs, rough edges, or things that just don't feel right — I'd genuinely love to hear about it.
